description: Filter an array by keeping or removing items that match values in a second array. Supports filtering by object property path.
label: Array Filter By

options.name: path
options.label: Path
options.info: If the source array contains objects, the dot-separated path to the property to compare. For example, 'user.id'

options.name: filterArray
options.label: Filter Array
options.info: The array of values to filter by

options.name: filterPath
options.label: Path
options.info: If the filter array contains objects, the dot-separated path to the property to compare. For example, 'userId'

options.name: mode
options.label: Mode
options.info: Include keeps only items that match. Exclude removes items that match.

options.name: schemaModel
options.label: Schema Model
options.info: The schema model to use for the output array
